description: Global Prior-Art Patent Invalidator — Screens a patent's claims against scholarly literature published before the priority date (arXiv, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, Crossref, HAL, J-STAGE; English, Chinese, Japanese, German; not patent databases). Give claims plus a priority date, or a patent number to read them from Google Patents. Claims are split into elements in code; every claim-chart quote is verified verbatim against the title or abst

patentClaimsText.description: Claims to attack, numbered as in the patent (e.g. "1. A method ..."). Optional when patentNumber is given: the independent claims are then read from Google Patents. A dependent claim is charted with every element of its parents.

patentNumber.description: Publication number such as US7629993B2. Claims, priority date and cited art are read from Google Patents when the claims or the date are omitted, and the date is cross-checked otherwise. Required unless both patentClaimsText and priorityDate are given.

priorityDate.description: Earliest effective filing/priority date, YYYY-MM-DD. Only works published strictly before it count. Optional when patentNumber is given; a supplied date wins over the Google Patents date and a disagreement is reported.

name: prior-art-invalidator
